title: AuditRun Status Chain by Recipient

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of the recipient to filter the status chain

query: MATCH (r:Recipient {email:$email})-[:HAS_STATUS]->(s:DeliveryStatus) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:PREVIOUS_STATUS*]->(old:DeliveryStatus) OPTIONAL MATCH (a:AuditRun)-[:COMPARES]->(s) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:HAS_REFERENCE]->(u:LegalReference) RETURN r, a, s, old, u
